messages:
Mia L: Quick bench summary for L4 vs T4 vs A10G (embeddings + small-chat). Ran in us-west1 + eu-west1, small-chat = 1 prompt -> 256 gen tokens, embeddings = batch128. Grafana + CSV attached: https://grafana.internal/redwood/quickbench/1769001234 and s3://redwood-bench/quickbench/1769001234.csv

Raj P: nice — can you paste p50/p95/p99 and the cost-per-1M-tokens numbers here? also which quant and kernels?

Mia L: sure. configs: model=openlm-7b; quant -> q4_0 and q8_0 for embeddings; kernels tried = flash_attn (when available), cutlass, and default. batching: emb bs=128, chat bs=1/8/32. seq len=1024 for long-chat runs.

Mia L: Embeddings throughput (items/sec, bs128): A10G=22k, L4=9.1k, T4=6.4k. Latency for single-embedding request (p50/p95): A10G=6ms/18ms, L4=14ms/48ms, T4=20ms/80ms.

Mia L: Small-chat (gen 256 tokens) p50/p95/p99, bs=1: A10G=110ms/230ms/510ms, L4=170ms/480ms/1.2s, T4=220ms/690ms/1.8s. Throughput (tokens/sec, gen-only steady state): A10G=28k, L4=12.5k, T4=7.8k.

Mia L: Rough cost estimates (compute-only, normalize to 1M generated tokens): small-chat: A10G ~$9.4 / 1M tok, L4 ~$14.8 / 1M tok, T4 ~$21.6 / 1M tok. embeddings (1M 768-d vectors at bs128): A10G ~$2.9, L4 ~$5.4, T4 ~$8.2. These use our internal hourly rates and observed throughput; treat as operational guidance not final pricing.

Olivia: curious — where did q4_0 vs q8_0 land for quality on chat? any regressions?

Mia L: q4_0 gave ~1.8 pt BLEU-ish metric drop on our convo evalset vs fp16 for openlm-7b under top-k sampling. q8_0 was within 0.2 pts. For embeddings, q4_0 cosine drop ~0.7% vs fp16 (acceptable for most apps).

Zack: interesting — kernel notes: flash_attn on A10G gave ~20% p50 win and ~15% throughput gain for chat. On L4 it improved p50 by ~8%, no meaningful throughput jump. On T4 flash_attn fallback often fell back to slower kernels for >1024 seq because of memory fragmentation.

Zack: also noticed CUTLASS path helps batch throughput for embeddings on L4, but increases p95 for bs=1 slightly.

Joan: what about KV cache overhead for small-chat? that matters for multi-turn.

Mia L: KV cache added ~12% memory + ~8% latency for first token but reduces total tokens run by ~35% with typical 4-turn convo (we measured end-to-end cost drop ~22% when cache hit rate high).

Raj P: can you drop the raw CSV? want to run our cost model on eu-west rates.

bench-bot: produced artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/quickbench/1769001234.csv (full runs), s3://redwood-bench/quickbench/1769001234-artifacts.tar.gz 

Olivia: saw any regional delta? how different was eu-west vs us-west?

Mia L: eu-west A10G ~+12% p50 vs us-west (hot-cloud variance), L4 similar-ish (+8% p50). T4 had more variance (+20% p50 and more p99 noise) — likely host CPU IO contention in that pool.

Zack: action: for production inference we should prefer A10G for both embeddings and small-chat if latency/SLO matters; L4 can be cost-effective for medium-throughput embedding-only workloads if you use CUTLASS optimized path and bigger batches. T4 we recommend only for very cheap short-seq jobs where memory is tight or if region pricing is dramatically lower.

Joan: anything on mixed-precision kernels / bf16?

Mia L: bf16 on A10G matches fp16 latency and improves stability vs aggressive int quant. We didn't do full bf16 QA here.

Raj P: can infra run a systematic p99 sweep across both regions for top 10 customer prompts? want to see worst-case tails.

Infra-bot: Scheduling job: bench-sweep-1769001234 -> targets: us-west1, eu-west1; GPUs: [A10G, L4, T4]; metrics: p50/p95/p99, OOMs, memory pattern, kernel chosen. ETA results ~ 2026-03-19T09:00Z.

Olivia: noted anomaly — one run had q4_0 + top-k=5 produce short hallucinations more often. recommend gating q4_0 for chat until we have more evals.

Mia L: agreed. proposal: embeddings -> q4_0 okay; chat -> prefer q8_0 or bf16 on L4/A10G. We'll add a decision table to model onboarding docs.

Zack: small snippet of the runner command if anyone wants to reproduce locally:
```
./run_bench --model openlm-7b --gpu a10g --quant q4_0 --kernel flash_attn --bs 128 --seq 1024 --type embeddings --out /tmp/1769001234.csv
```

Raj P: thanks — pushing this into the onboarding eval checklist. pls add a short line about kernel fallbacks per GPU.

Mia L: will do. next steps: (1) infra full p99 sweep (Infra-bot) (2) add gating rule for q4_0 on chat to onboarding doc (me) (3) follow-up A/B eval for q4_0 vs q8_0 with top-k/temp configs (Olivia). :thumbsup:
